text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to run a record-breaking historic race in the autumn Tenno Sho, we've devised a secret plan for summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That plan is to work with Sakura Bakushin O! If you're talking speed, she's the first person that comes to mind. Training begins at four in the morning—huh?! Four?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But there's no time to complain. The two of them begin to Bakushin.
